title: Privacy Policy
intro: Golden Mind Academy respects your privacy. This website is a simple informational site, and we collect as little as possible.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: We do not use cookies, analytics, or tracking of any kind. Browsing this site sends us no information about you.

sections.heading: The contact form
sections.body: If you use the contact form, your name, email address, and message are delivered to us by Formspree, a form-handling service, so we can reply to you. We use this information only to respond, and we never sell or share it.

sections.heading: Donations
sections.body: Donations are processed entirely by GoFundMe on their platform, under [GoFundMe's own terms and privacy policy](https://www.gofundme.com/c/terms). We never see or store your payment details.
